import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
noncomputable section
namespace SL2Reduction
abbrev Index (lam : ℤ) := Fin (lam.toNat + 1)
def localRing (p : ℕ) : Subalgebra ℤ ℚ :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℤ {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := ↥(localRing p)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (localRing p).val.toRingHom).toAlgebra
instance ratComplexTower (p : ℕ) : IsScalarTower (R p) ℚ ℂ :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
instance (priority := 50) localModule (p : ℕ) : Module (R p) V := Module.restrictScalars (R p) ℂ V
instance (priority := 50) localTower (p : ℕ) : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.restrictScalars (R p) ℂ V
def divided (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := divided y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := R p ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def iota (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
def localizedImage (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  (iota p M).range
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  (localizedImage p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def J (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) := Ji p M y v 0
def qmul (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
  (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ :=
  (J p M y v).subtype.liftBaseChange ℚ

def Preserves (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : M, f (m : V) ∈ M
def RPreserves (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ localizedImage p M, f u ∈ localizedImage p M
structure LatticeOps (M : Submodule ℤ V) where
  x : Module.End ℤ M
  y : Module.End ℤ M
  h : Module.End ℤ M
  X : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M
  Y : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M
def Agrees (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (a : LatticeOps M) : Prop :=
  (∀ m : M, (a.x m : V) = x (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ m : M, (a.y m : V) = y (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ m : M, (a.h m : V) = h (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ r (m : M), (a.X r m : V) = divided x r (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ r (m : M), (a.Y r m : V) = divided y r (m : V))
def Invariant {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (W : Submodule F U) (f : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ W, f u ∈ W
def Simple {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial U ∧ ∀ W : Submodule F U,
    Invariant W x → Invariant W y → Invariant W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
def Highest (lam : ℤ) (x h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = (lam : ℂ) • w
def Admissible (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M) (c : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V),
    ∀ i, (b i : V) = c i) ∧
  ∀ r : ℕ, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)
def extendFamily {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (i : ℕ) : U :=
  if hi : i < lam.toNat + 1 then b ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def GeneratorFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Index lam,
    x (b i) = (if i.val = 0 then 0 else
      (((lam - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val - 1))) ∧
    y (b i) = ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val + 1) ∧
    h (b i) = (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • b i)
def DividedFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (X Y : ℕ → Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Index lam) (r : ℕ),
    X r (b i) = (if r ≤ i.val then
      ((Nat.choose (lam.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val - r)
      else 0) ∧
    Y r (b i) = ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val + r)
def E (lam : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V) (i j : Index lam) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def MatrixWord {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (X Y : ℕ → Module.End F U) (i j : Index lam) : Module.End F U :=
  ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : F)⁻¹) •
    (X (lam.toNat - i.val) * (Y lam.toNat * X lam.toNat) * Y (lam.toNat - j.val))
def BasisLift (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M),
    ∀ i, iota p M (c i) = b • e y v i.val
def Principal (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  b ≠ 0 ∧ J p M y v = Submodule.span (R p) {b}
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a ∧
    Simple (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)


def Lowering (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℕ,
    h ((y ^ t) v) = (((lam - 2 * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
    x ((y ^ (t + 1)) v) =
      (((((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * (lam - (t : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ t) v)
def CoordinateCore (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, ∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) ∧
  (∀ t : ℕ, lam.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
  GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) x y h
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ((lam.toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = lam + 1 ∧
  0 < lam.toNat + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Index lam) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
  Lowering lam x y h v ∧
  (∀ i : Index lam, e y v i.val ≠ 0) ∧
  CoordinateCore lam x y h v ∧
  DividedFormulas lam (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) (divided x) (divided y)
def LocalLattice (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (iota p M) ∧
  (iota p M).range = Submodule.span (R p) (M : Set V) ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (localizedImage p M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ r, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r) ∧
    RPreserves p M (divided x r) ∧ RPreserves p M (divided y r)) ∧
  Preserves M x ∧ Preserves M y ∧ Preserves M h ∧
  RPreserves p M x ∧ RPreserves p M y ∧ RPreserves p M h ∧
  ∃ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a
def MatrixIdentities (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) →
  ∀ i j : Index lam,
    (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) =
      E lam b (Fin.last lam.toNat) (Fin.last lam.toNat) ∧
    divided x (lam.toNat - i.val) * (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) =
      E lam b i (Fin.last lam.toNat) ∧
    (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) * divided y (lam.toNat - j.val) =
      (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℂ) • E lam b (Fin.last lam.toNat) j ∧
    (∃ c : R p, (c : ℚ) = (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℚ) ∧ IsUnit c) ∧
    E lam b i j = MatrixWord lam (divided x) (divided y) i j ∧
    RPreserves p M (E lam b i j)
def CommonModule (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Index lam, Ji p M y v i.val = J p M y v) ∧
  Nontrivial (J p M y v) ∧ Module.Finite (R p) (J p M y v) ∧
  ∃ c : (Index lam → J p M y v) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M,
    ∀ g, iota p M (c g) = ∑ i : Index lam, (g i : ℂ) • e y v i.val
def RationalLine (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (qmul p M y v) ∧
  (qmul p M y v).range = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M y v : Set ℂ) ∧
  Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) ∧
  Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) = 1
def PrincipalLattice (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  RationalLine p M y v ∧ (∃ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b) ∧
  ∀ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b → BasisLift p lam M y v b
def TensorMaps (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (hp : CharP K p) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (kap : R p →+* K) : Prop :=
  letI : CharP K p := hp
  letI : Algebra (R p) K := kap.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
  ∃ (phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M))
    (psi : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)),
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (u : MR p M), psi (c ⊗ₜ[R p] u) =
      c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] (ModN.mkQ p u)) ∧
    (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (z : VK K M),
      phi (f.baseChange K z) = (f.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
    (∀ f : Module.End (R p) (MR p M),
      ∃ fbar : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (MR p M) p),
        (∀ u, fbar (ModN.mkQ p u) = ModN.mkQ p (f u)) ∧
        ∀ z, psi (f.baseChange K z) = fbar.baseChange K (psi z))
def ScalarReduction (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ (hp : CharP K p) (kap : R p →+* K),
    (∀ (r : R p) (a b : ℤ), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
      (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → kap r = (a : K) / (b : K)) ∧
    TensorMaps p K hp M kap
def ReducedBasis (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a →
  ∃ (beta : Module.Basis (Index lam) K (VK K M)) (b : ℂ),
    Principal p M y v b ∧
    (∃ (kap : R p →+* K),
      letI : Algebra (R p) K := kap.toAlgebra
      ∃ (phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M))
        (c : Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M)),
        (∀ (s : K) (m : M), phi (s ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = s ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
        (∀ i, iota p M (c i) = b • e y v i.val) ∧
        ∀ i, phi (beta i) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (c i)) ∧
    Module.finrank K (VK K M) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
    GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i => beta i) (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)
def ReducedUnits (lam : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ j : Index lam, (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat →
      (a.X r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (a.x.baseChange K) ^ r ∧
      (a.Y r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (a.y.baseChange K) ^ r) ∧
    ∃ beta : Module.Basis (Index lam) K (VK K M),
      GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i => beta i) (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K) ∧
      ∀ i j k : Index lam,
        MatrixWord lam (fun r => (a.X r).baseChange K) (fun r => (a.Y r).baseChange K) i j (beta k) =
          if j = k then beta i else 0

end SL2Reduction

import Mathlib
open scoped TensorProduct
noncomputable section
namespace SL2Reduction
abbrev Index (lam : ℤ) := Fin (lam.toNat + 1)
def localRing (p : ℕ) : Subalgebra ℤ ℚ :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℤ {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := ↥(localRing p)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (localRing p).val.toRingHom).toAlgebra
instance ratComplexTower (p : ℕ) : IsScalarTower (R p) ℚ ℂ :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
instance (priority := 50) localModule (p : ℕ) : Module (R p) V := Module.restrictScalars (R p) ℂ V
instance (priority := 50) localTower (p : ℕ) : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.restrictScalars (R p) ℂ V
def divided (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := divided y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := R p ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def iota (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
def localizedImage (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  (iota p M).range
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  (localizedImage p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def J (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) := Ji p M y v 0
def qmul (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
  (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ :=
  (J p M y v).subtype.liftBaseChange ℚ

def Preserves (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : M, f (m : V) ∈ M
def RPreserves (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ localizedImage p M, f u ∈ localizedImage p M
structure LatticeOps (M : Submodule ℤ V) where
  x : Module.End ℤ M
  y : Module.End ℤ M
  h : Module.End ℤ M
  X : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M
  Y : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M
def Agrees (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (a : LatticeOps M) : Prop :=
  (∀ m : M, (a.x m : V) = x (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ m : M, (a.y m : V) = y (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ m : M, (a.h m : V) = h (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ r (m : M), (a.X r m : V) = divided x r (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ r (m : M), (a.Y r m : V) = divided y r (m : V))
def Invariant {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (W : Submodule F U) (f : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ W, f u ∈ W
def Simple {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial U ∧ ∀ W : Submodule F U,
    Invariant W x → Invariant W y → Invariant W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
def Highest (lam : ℤ) (x h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = (lam : ℂ) • w
def Admissible (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M) (c : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V),
    ∀ i, (b i : V) = c i) ∧
  ∀ r : ℕ, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)
def extendFamily {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (i : ℕ) : U :=
  if hi : i < lam.toNat + 1 then b ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def GeneratorFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Index lam,
    x (b i) = (if i.val = 0 then 0 else
      (((lam - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val - 1))) ∧
    y (b i) = ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val + 1) ∧
    h (b i) = (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • b i)
def DividedFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (X Y : ℕ → Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Index lam) (r : ℕ),
    X r (b i) = (if r ≤ i.val then
      ((Nat.choose (lam.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val - r)
      else 0) ∧
    Y r (b i) = ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val + r)
def E (lam : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V) (i j : Index lam) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def MatrixWord {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (X Y : ℕ → Module.End F U) (i j : Index lam) : Module.End F U :=
  ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : F)⁻¹) •
    (X (lam.toNat - i.val) * (Y lam.toNat * X lam.toNat) * Y (lam.toNat - j.val))
def BasisLift (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M),
    ∀ i, iota p M (c i) = b • e y v i.val
def Principal (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  b ≠ 0 ∧ J p M y v = Submodule.span (R p) {b}
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a ∧
    Simple (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)


def Lowering (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℕ,
    h ((y ^ t) v) = (((lam - 2 * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
    x ((y ^ (t + 1)) v) =
      (((((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * (lam - (t : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ t) v)
def CoordinateCore (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, ∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) ∧
  (∀ t : ℕ, lam.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
  GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) x y h
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ((lam.toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = lam + 1 ∧
  0 < lam.toNat + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Index lam) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
  Lowering lam x y h v ∧
  (∀ i : Index lam, e y v i.val ≠ 0) ∧
  CoordinateCore lam x y h v ∧
  DividedFormulas lam (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) (divided x) (divided y)
def LocalLattice (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (iota p M) ∧
  (iota p M).range = Submodule.span (R p) (M : Set V) ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (localizedImage p M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ r, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r) ∧
    RPreserves p M (divided x r) ∧ RPreserves p M (divided y r)) ∧
  Preserves M x ∧ Preserves M y ∧ Preserves M h ∧
  RPreserves p M x ∧ RPreserves p M y ∧ RPreserves p M h ∧
  ∃ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a
def MatrixIdentities (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) →
  ∀ i j : Index lam,
    (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) =
      E lam b (Fin.last lam.toNat) (Fin.last lam.toNat) ∧
    divided x (lam.toNat - i.val) * (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) =
      E lam b i (Fin.last lam.toNat) ∧
    (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) * divided y (lam.toNat - j.val) =
      (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℂ) • E lam b (Fin.last lam.toNat) j ∧
    (∃ c : R p, (c : ℚ) = (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℚ) ∧ IsUnit c) ∧
    E lam b i j = MatrixWord lam (divided x) (divided y) i j ∧
    RPreserves p M (E lam b i j)
def CommonModule (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Index lam, Ji p M y v i.val = J p M y v) ∧
  Nontrivial (J p M y v) ∧ Module.Finite (R p) (J p M y v) ∧
  ∃ c : (Index lam → J p M y v) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M,
    ∀ g, iota p M (c g) = ∑ i : Index lam, (g i : ℂ) • e y v i.val
def RationalLine (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (qmul p M y v) ∧
  (qmul p M y v).range = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M y v : Set ℂ) ∧
  Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) ∧
  Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) = 1
def PrincipalLattice (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  RationalLine p M y v ∧ (∃ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b) ∧
  ∀ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b → BasisLift p lam M y v b
def TensorMaps (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (hp : CharP K p) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (kap : R p →+* K) : Prop :=
  letI : CharP K p := hp
  letI : Algebra (R p) K := kap.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
  ∃ (phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M))
    (psi : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)),
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (u : MR p M), psi (c ⊗ₜ[R p] u) =
      c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] (ModN.mkQ p u)) ∧
    (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (z : VK K M),
      phi (f.baseChange K z) = (f.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
    (∀ f : Module.End (R p) (MR p M),
      ∃ fbar : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (MR p M) p),
        (∀ u, fbar (ModN.mkQ p u) = ModN.mkQ p (f u)) ∧
        ∀ z, psi (f.baseChange K z) = fbar.baseChange K (psi z))
def ScalarReduction (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ (hp : CharP K p) (kap : R p →+* K),
    (∀ (r : R p) (a b : ℤ), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
      (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → kap r = (a : K) / (b : K)) ∧
    TensorMaps p K hp M kap
def ReducedBasis (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a →
  ∃ (beta : Module.Basis (Index lam) K (VK K M)) (b : ℂ),
    Principal p M y v b ∧
    (∃ (kap : R p →+* K),
      letI : Algebra (R p) K := kap.toAlgebra
      ∃ (phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M))
        (c : Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M)),
        (∀ (s : K) (m : M), phi (s ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = s ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
        (∀ i, iota p M (c i) = b • e y v i.val) ∧
        ∀ i, phi (beta i) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (c i)) ∧
    Module.finrank K (VK K M) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
    GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i => beta i) (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)
def ReducedUnits (lam : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ j : Index lam, (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat →
      (a.X r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (a.x.baseChange K) ^ r ∧
      (a.Y r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (a.y.baseChange K) ^ r) ∧
    ∃ beta : Module.Basis (Index lam) K (VK K M),
      GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i => beta i) (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K) ∧
      ∀ i j k : Index lam,
        MatrixWord lam (fun r => (a.X r).baseChange K) (fun r => (a.Y r).baseChange K) i j (beta k) =
          if j = k then beta i else 0

end SL2Reduction

premise_types.H003: Module.Finite ℂ V ∧ Module.finrank ℂ V = (lam + 1).toNat ∧ h * x - x * h = (2 : ℂ) • x ∧ h * y - y * h = (-2 : ℂ) • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h ∧ Highest lam x h ∧ Simple x y h
premise_types.H004: v ≠ 0 ∧ x v = 0 ∧ h v = (lam : ℂ) • v

artifact.conclusion_type: Target K M x y h
artifact.representation: V is an arbitrary complex vector space and x,y,h are its complex-linear Chevalley actions. H003 retains finite dimension, all three commutators, a highest vector of weight λ and irreducibility under the generating actions; this is the operator presentation of the given sl₂-module, with the specified v retained separately in H004. λ remains an integer. Under H002, Index λ = Fin(λ.toNat+1) identifies bijectively with {i∈ℤ | 0≤i≤λ}; natural differences are used only inside this range. M is a ℤ-submodule of V; H005 supplies an arbitrary integer basis that is also a complex basis, and stability under every divided power. R is the ℤ-subalgebra of ℚ generated by the displayed prime-to-p fractions, with its exact original carrier established by T005; it is not assumed to be the whole ℚ. MR=R⊗ℤM and iota is the actual scalar multiplication lift; identifying with its image is justified only by N002. J_i and J are preimages of that image under c↦c e_i. qmul is the actual multiplication map ℚ⊗R J→ℂ. Scalar-first VK=K⊗ℤM is the same source tensor construction with factors swapped; T014 uses this convention throughout. ModN(MR,p) is the quotient by the image of multiplication by p. LatticeOps carries the actual restrictions, and Agrees specifies each value, rather than adding any action assumption. The target constructs these unique restrictions and states nonzero VK and every K-submodule invariant under x,y,h is bottom or top. Proposition-valued definitions only package displayed obligations; none proves them. Endomorphism multiplication is composition, integer coefficients are cast to the indicated field, and all factorials/choose arguments are natural numbers.

steps.statement: Lowering lam x y h v
steps.explanation: Simultaneous natural induction using the three commutators. Natural t and t+1 encode the source nonnegative and positive integer powers.

steps.statement: ∀ i : Index lam, e y v i.val ≠ 0 ∧ h (e y v i.val) = (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • e y v i.val)
steps.explanation: Iterate the x identity, obtaining i! times the descending product; all factors are nonzero over ℂ for i≤λ. Divide by i! and retain the weight formula.

steps.statement: CoordinateCore lam x y h v
steps.explanation: Isolate coefficients by products of h minus the other complex weights, use dimension to obtain the e basis, exclude the additional weight −λ−2, and derive terminated generator strings. No reduced-weight assertion is used.

steps.statement: Coordinates lam x y h v
steps.explanation: Export all of N001, including the count, lowering identities, nonzero vectors, basis, termination, and integral binomial divided-power formulas. Iterate the generator formulas and use zero-extended families at the ends.

steps.statement: (∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ localRing p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) ∧ IsFractionRing (R p) ℚ
steps.explanation: Representation bridge for D007: the displayed fractions are closed under ring operations when p is prime, so their ℤ-adjoin has exactly that carrier. Since it contains ℤ and embeds in ℚ, ℚ is its fraction field. This establishes the concrete localization meaning before using its denominators.

steps.statement: LocalLattice p lam M x y h
steps.explanation: Extend an arbitrary admissible integer basis to R; compare its image in V to prove iota injective, free rank n, and full complex span. Use stability under divided powers and h=xy−yx; construct, rather than assume, the integer lattice restrictions LatticeOps.

steps.statement: LocalLattice p lam M x y h ∧ MatrixIdentities p lam M x y v
steps.explanation: Export N002. Evaluate Pi and the two edge products on the e basis. Use λ

steps.statement: ∀ i : Index lam, Ji p M y v i.val = J p M y v
steps.explanation: Matrix units transport c e_j to c e_i; reverse i,j to prove equality. The zero index is present because H002 identifies Fin(λ.toNat+1) with the source interval.

steps.statement: CommonModule p lam M y v
steps.explanation: Export N003. The finite sum of J coordinates gives the displayed R-linear isomorphism with MR, using iota injectivity and the complex e basis. Diagonal images of finitely many generators make J finite; full span makes it nonzero.

steps.statement: Function.Injective (qmul p M y v) ∧ (qmul p M y v).range = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M y v : Set ℂ) ∧ Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v)
steps.explanation: Clear a common nonzero denominator in a finite tensor sum. Its image is c/d, so vanishing forces c=0. Finite generation of J yields finite-dimensional rational scalar extension.

Tensor the explicit coordinate isomorphism with ℚ. Use Module.finrank_baseChange on MR and Module.finrank_pi_fintype on the finite constant family QJ directly, with the actual freeness/finiteness conditions, to obtain n=nr and hence r=1. The balanced coordinate inverse avoids a flatness assumption.

steps.statement: ∃ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b
steps.explanation: Choose a nonzero rational-line vector and finitely many nonzero generators. Write each rational coefficient as p^eta times a unit of R and choose the minimum exponent. Prove both inclusions J=Rb; no PID shortcut replaces this supplied argument.

steps.statement: PrincipalLattice p lam M y v
steps.explanation: Export N004, including rational multiplication injectivity, rational span and rank one, existence of b, and an R-basis for every nonzero b generating J. Construct the basis using the common-module coordinate isomorphism.

Construct κ by fractions, then the two canonical scalar-first tensor isomorphisms by the source pure-tensor formulas and their inverses. ModN(MR,p) is literally MR/pMR and has its canonical ZMod p action. Prove naturality for lattice endomorphisms; the intermediate R and ZMod algebra structures are supplied explicitly inside TensorMaps.

steps.statement: ReducedBasis p lam K M x y h v
steps.explanation: Choose b from N004, scalar-extend its R-basis, and pull it back through the natural tensor isomorphism. Keep the exact basis/image equation, then transfer the integer generator matrices and dimension.

steps.statement: ScalarReduction p K M ∧ ReducedBasis p lam K M x y h v ∧ ReducedUnits lam K M x y h
steps.explanation: Export N005. Prove all factorials through λ and all relevant binomials nonzero in K. Extend r!X_r=x^r and r!Y_r=y^r, reduce the original matrix-unit identity through the same scaled basis, and obtain the delta action. Indices are natural differences guarded by i,j≤λ.

steps.statement: ∀ (a : LatticeOps M) (W : Submodule K (VK K M)), Agrees M x y h a → Invariant W (a.x.baseChange K) → Invariant W (a.y.baseChange K) → Invariant W (a.h.baseChange K) → ∀ i j : Index lam, Invariant W (MatrixWord lam (fun r => (a.X r).baseChange K) (fun r => (a.Y r).baseChange K) i j)
steps.explanation: Powers of preserving x,y preserve W. For every index in MatrixWord, N005 identifies the divided powers with scalar multiples of those powers; scalar multiplication and composition preserve W.

steps.statement: ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a → Simple (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)
steps.explanation: Use the N005 beta basis and separate zero/nonzero W. In the nonzero case choose a single compatible vector, coefficient family, and nonzero coordinate; apply the matrix word and divide to put every beta_i in W. Basis cardinality λ.toNat+1 supplies nontriviality. All temporary witnesses remain local.

steps.statement: Target K M x y h
steps.explanation: Choose the actual lattice restrictions guaranteed by N002 and apply T018. Agrees pins their values uniquely on M. Nontriviality and the zero/top invariant-subspace alternative are the complete target; invariance under the three Chevalley generators is equivalent to invariance under their K-span, including characteristic two.

P.explanation: For arbitrary prime p, arbitrary field K with CharP K p, integer 0≤λ<p, the given finite-dimensional complex irreducible highest-weight module and vector, and any admissible lattice M, H001–H005 encode the original hypotheses. The three endomorphisms give the Chevalley action through the relations [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=−2y, [x,y]=h; their invariant complex subspaces are exactly the sl₂-submodules, so Highest plus Simple describes the stated irreducible highest-weight module. H005 asserts the original integer/complex basis condition and all divided-power stability, equivalently U_Z-stability. There is no minimal-lattice assumption. Tensor commutation m⊗c↦c⊗m identifies source M⊗ℤK with VK; its inverse swaps factors and it intertwines all extended lattice operators. Target existentially constructs their restrictions a, requiring Agrees on every m∈M, so each restriction is unique and is the original lattice action. Conversely the original induced action supplies such a. Simple explicitly says Nontrivial VK and universally quantifies every K-submodule W with the three invariance hypotheses and conclusion W=⊥ or W=⊤. This is equivalent to the whole stated target because the three abstract Chevalley generators span L(K), including at p=2. No distinct reduced weights, algebraic closure, or positive λ is assumed; λ=0 remains allowed. Restriction existence is already a derived N002 obligation, not a new premise.

33: variable [AddMonoidWithOne R] (p : ℕ)

35: /-- The generator of the kernel of the unique homomorphism ℕ → R for a semiring R.
36: 
37: *Warning*: for a semiring `R`, `CharP R 0` and `CharZero R` need not coincide.
38: * `CharP R 0` asks that only `0 : ℕ` maps to `0 : R` under the map `ℕ → R`;
39: * `CharZero R` requires an injection `ℕ ↪ R`.
40: 
41: For instance, endowing `{0, 1}` with addition given by `max` (i.e. `1` is absorbing), shows that
42: `CharZero {0, 1}` does not hold and yet `CharP {0, 1} 0` does.
43: This example is formalized in `Counterexamples/CharPZeroNeCharZero.lean`.
44: -/
45: @[mk_iff]
46: class _root_.CharP (R : Type*) [AddMonoidWithOne R] (p : outParam ℕ) : Prop where
47:   cast_eq_zero_iff (R p) : ∀ x : ℕ, (x : R) = 0 ↔ p ∣ x
48: 
49: variable [CharP R p] {a b : ℕ}
50: 
51: lemma _root_.CharP.ofNat_eq_zero' (p : ℕ) [CharP R p]
52:     (a : ℕ) [a.AtLeastTwo] (h : p ∣ a) :
53:     (ofNat(a) : R) = 0 := by
54:   rwa [← CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p] at h
55: 
56: variable {R} in
57: lemma congr {q : ℕ} (h : p = q) : CharP R q := h ▸ ‹CharP R p›
58: 
59: @[simp] lemma cast_eq_zero : (p : R) = 0 := (cast_eq_zero_iff R p p).2 dvd_rfl
60: 
61: lemma cast_eq_mod (k : ℕ) : (k : R) = (k % p : ℕ) :=
62:   have (a : ℕ) : ((p * a : ℕ) : R) = 0 := by
63:     rw [CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p]
64:     exact Nat.dvd_mul_right p a
65:   calc
66:     (k : R) = ↑(k % p + p * (k / p)) := by rw [Nat.mod_add_div]
67:     _ = ↑(k % p) := by simp [this]
68: 
69: lemma cast_eq_iff_mod_eq [IsLeftCancelAdd R] : (a : R) = (b : R) ↔ a % p = b % p := by
70:   wlog! hle : a ≤ b
71:   · simpa only [eq_comm] using (this _ _ hle.le)
72:   obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hle
73:   rw [Nat.cast_add, left_eq_add, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R p]
74:   constructor
75:   · simp +contextual [Nat.add_mod, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
76:   intro h
77:   have := Nat.sub_mod_eq_zero_of_mod_eq h.symm
78:   simpa [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] using this
79: 
80: -- TODO: This lemma needs to be `@[simp]` for confluence in the presence of `CharP.cast_eq_zero` and
81: -- `Nat.cast_ofNat`, but with `no_index` on its entire LHS, it matches literally every expression so
82: -- is too expensive. If https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/issues/2867 is fixed in a performant way, this can be made `@[simp]`.
83: --
84: -- @[simp]
85: lemma ofNat_eq_zero [p.AtLeastTwo] : (ofNat(p) : R) = 0 := cast_eq_zero R p
86: 
87: lemma eq {p q : ℕ} (hp : CharP R p) (hq : CharP R q) : p = q :=
88:   Nat.dvd_antisymm ((cast_eq_zero_iff (self := hp) R p q).1 (@cast_eq_zero _ _ _ hq))
89:     ((cast_eq_zero_iff (self := hq) R q p).1 (@cast_eq_zero _ _ _ hp))
90: 
91: instance ofCharZero [CharZero R] : CharP R 0 where
92:   cast_eq_zero_iff x := by rw [zero_dvd_iff, ← Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_inj]
93: 
94: end AddMonoidWithOne

97: variable [AddGroupWithOne R] (p : ℕ) [CharP R p] {a b : ℤ}
98: 
99: lemma intCast_eq_zero_iff (a : ℤ) : (a : R) = 0 ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ a := by

30: /-- Linear endomorphisms of a module, with associated ring structure
31: `Module.End.semiring` and algebra structure `Module.End.algebra`. -/
32: abbrev Module.End (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] :=
33:   M →ₗ[R] M
34: 
35: variable {R R₂ S M M₁ M₂ M₃ N₁ : Type*}
36: 
37: open Function LinearMap
38: 
39: /-!
40: ## Monoid structure of endomorphisms
41: -/
42: 
43: namespace Module.End
44: 
45: variable [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommGroup N₁] [Module R M] [Module R N₁]
46: 
47: instance : One (Module.End R M) := ⟨LinearMap.id⟩
48: 
49: instance : Mul (Module.End R M) := ⟨fun f g => LinearMap.comp f g⟩
50: 
51: theorem one_eq_id : (1 : Module.End R M) = .id := rfl
52: 
53: theorem mul_eq_comp (f g : Module.End R M) : f * g = f.comp g := rfl
54: 
55: @[simp]
56: theorem one_apply (x : M) : (1 : Module.End R M) x = x := rfl
57: 
58: @[simp]
59: theorem mul_apply (f g : Module.End R M) (x : M) : (f * g) x = f (g x) := rfl
60: 
61: theorem coe_one : ⇑(1 : Module.End R M) = _root_.id := rfl
62: 
63: theorem coe_mul (f g : Module.End R M) : ⇑(f * g) = f ∘ g := rfl
64: 
65: instance instNontrivial [Nontrivial M] : Nontrivial (Module.End R M) := by
66:   obtain ⟨m, ne⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
67:   exact nontrivial_of_ne 1 0 fun p => ne (LinearMap.congr_fun p m)
68: 
69: instance instMonoid : Monoid (Module.End R M) where
70:   mul_assoc _ _ _ := LinearMap.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
71:   mul_one := comp_id
72:   one_mul := id_comp
73: 
74: instance instSemiring : Semiring (Module.End R M) where
75:   __ := AddMonoidWithOne.unary
76:   __ := instMonoid
77:   __ := addCommMonoid
78:   mul_zero := comp_zero
79:   zero_mul := zero_comp
80:   left_distrib := fun _ _ _ ↦ comp_add _ _ _
81:   right_distrib := fun _ _ _ ↦ add_comp _ _ _
82:   natCast := fun n ↦ n • (1 : M →ₗ[R] M)
83:   natCast_zero := zero_smul ℕ (1 : M →ₗ[R] M)
84:   natCast_succ := fun n ↦ AddMonoid.nsmul_succ n (1 : M →ₗ[R] M)
85: 
86: /-- See also `Module.End.natCast_def`. -/
87: @[simp]
88: theorem natCast_apply (n : ℕ) (m : M) : (↑n : Module.End R M) m = n • m := rfl

import Mathlib

noncomputable section
namespace SL2Reduction
abbrev Index (lam : ℤ) := Fin (lam.toNat + 1)
def localRing (p : ℕ) : Subalgebra ℤ ℚ :=
  Algebra.adjoin ℤ {q : ℚ | ∃ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)}
abbrev R (p : ℕ) := ↥(localRing p)
instance complexAlgebra (p : ℕ) : Algebra (R p) ℂ :=
  ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (localRing p).val.toRingHom).toAlgebra
instance ratComplexTower (p : ℕ) : IsScalarTower (R p) ℚ ℂ :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ => rfl)
variable {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
instance (priority := 50) localModule (p : ℕ) : Module (R p) V := Module.restrictScalars (R p) ℂ V
instance (priority := 50) localTower (p : ℕ) : IsScalarTower (R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.restrictScalars (R p) ℂ V
def divided (f : Module.End ℂ V) (r : ℕ) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  ((r.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹) • f ^ r
def e (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : V := divided y i v
abbrev MR (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) := R p ⊗[ℤ] M
abbrev VK (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) := K ⊗[ℤ] M
def iota (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V :=
  M.subtype.liftBaseChange (R p)
def localizedImage (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Submodule (R p) V :=
  (iota p M).range
def Ji (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (i : ℕ) : Submodule (R p) ℂ :=
  (localizedImage p M).comap ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℂ V (e y v i)).restrictScalars (R p))
def J (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) := Ji p M y v 0
def qmul (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) :
  (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ :=
  (J p M y v).subtype.liftBaseChange ℚ

def Preserves (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ m : M, f (m : V) ∈ M
def RPreserves (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (f : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ localizedImage p M, f u ∈ localizedImage p M
structure LatticeOps (M : Submodule ℤ V) where
  x : Module.End ℤ M
  y : Module.End ℤ M
  h : Module.End ℤ M
  X : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M
  Y : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M
def Agrees (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (a : LatticeOps M) : Prop :=
  (∀ m : M, (a.x m : V) = x (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ m : M, (a.y m : V) = y (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ m : M, (a.h m : V) = h (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ r (m : M), (a.X r m : V) = divided x r (m : V)) ∧
  (∀ r (m : M), (a.Y r m : V) = divided y r (m : V))
def Invariant {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (W : Submodule F U) (f : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ W, f u ∈ W
def Simple {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  Nontrivial U ∧ ∀ W : Submodule F U,
    Invariant W x → Invariant W y → Invariant W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
def Highest (lam : ℤ) (x h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : V, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = (lam : ℂ) • w
def Admissible (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∃ (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M) (c : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V),
    ∀ i, (b i : V) = c i) ∧
  ∀ r : ℕ, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)
def extendFamily {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (i : ℕ) : U :=
  if hi : i < lam.toNat + 1 then b ⟨i, hi⟩ else 0
def GeneratorFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (x y h : Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Index lam,
    x (b i) = (if i.val = 0 then 0 else
      (((lam - (i.val : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val - 1))) ∧
    y (b i) = ((i.val + 1 : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val + 1) ∧
    h (b i) = (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : F) • b i)
def DividedFormulas {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (b : Index lam → U) (X Y : ℕ → Module.End F U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Index lam) (r : ℕ),
    X r (b i) = (if r ≤ i.val then
      ((Nat.choose (lam.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val - r)
      else 0) ∧
    Y r (b i) = ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : F) • extendFamily (F := F) lam b (i.val + r)
def E (lam : ℤ) (b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V) (i j : Index lam) : Module.End ℂ V :=
  (b.coord j).smulRight (b i)
def MatrixWord {F U : Type*} [Field F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U]
    (lam : ℤ) (X Y : ℕ → Module.End F U) (i j : Index lam) : Module.End F U :=
  ((Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : F)⁻¹) •
    (X (lam.toNat - i.val) * (Y lam.toNat * X lam.toNat) * Y (lam.toNat - j.val))
def BasisLift (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M),
    ∀ i, iota p M (c i) = b • e y v i.val
def Principal (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (b : ℂ) : Prop :=
  b ≠ 0 ∧ J p M y v = Submodule.span (R p) {b}
def Target (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a ∧
    Simple (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)


def Lowering (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : ℕ,
    h ((y ^ t) v) = (((lam - 2 * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
    x ((y ^ (t + 1)) v) =
      (((((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) * (lam - (t : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℂ) • (y ^ t) v)
def CoordinateCore (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∃ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, ∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) ∧
  (∀ t : ℕ, lam.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
  GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) x y h
def Coordinates (lam : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ((lam.toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = lam + 1 ∧
  0 < lam.toNat + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Index lam) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
  Lowering lam x y h v ∧
  (∀ i : Index lam, e y v i.val ≠ 0) ∧
  CoordinateCore lam x y h v ∧
  DividedFormulas lam (fun i : Index lam => e y v i.val) (divided x) (divided y)
def LocalLattice (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (iota p M) ∧
  (iota p M).range = Submodule.span (R p) (M : Set V) ∧
  Nonempty (Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
  Submodule.span ℂ (localizedImage p M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
  (∀ r, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r) ∧
    RPreserves p M (divided x r) ∧ RPreserves p M (divided y r)) ∧
  Preserves M x ∧ Preserves M y ∧ Preserves M h ∧
  RPreserves p M x ∧ RPreserves p M y ∧ RPreserves p M h ∧
  ∃ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a
def MatrixIdentities (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V, (∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) →
  ∀ i j : Index lam,
    (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) =
      E lam b (Fin.last lam.toNat) (Fin.last lam.toNat) ∧
    divided x (lam.toNat - i.val) * (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) =
      E lam b i (Fin.last lam.toNat) ∧
    (divided y lam.toNat * divided x lam.toNat) * divided y (lam.toNat - j.val) =
      (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℂ) • E lam b (Fin.last lam.toNat) j ∧
    (∃ c : R p, (c : ℚ) = (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : ℚ) ∧ IsUnit c) ∧
    E lam b i j = MatrixWord lam (divided x) (divided y) i j ∧
    RPreserves p M (E lam b i j)
def CommonModule (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Index lam, Ji p M y v i.val = J p M y v) ∧
  Nontrivial (J p M y v) ∧ Module.Finite (R p) (J p M y v) ∧
  ∃ c : (Index lam → J p M y v) ≃ₗ[R p] MR p M,
    ∀ g, iota p M (c g) = ∑ i : Index lam, (g i : ℂ) • e y v i.val
def RationalLine (p : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℤ V) (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (qmul p M y v) ∧
  (qmul p M y v).range = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M y v : Set ℂ) ∧
  Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) ∧
  Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M y v) = 1
def PrincipalLattice (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (y : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  RationalLine p M y v ∧ (∃ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b) ∧
  ∀ b : ℂ, Principal p M y v b → BasisLift p lam M y v b
def TensorMaps (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (hp : CharP K p) (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (kap : R p →+* K) : Prop :=
  letI : CharP K p := hp
  letI : Algebra (R p) K := kap.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := ZMod.algebra K p
  ∃ (phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M))
    (psi : (K ⊗[R p] MR p M) ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (MR p M) p)),
    (∀ (c : K) (m : M), phi (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
    (∀ (c : K) (u : MR p M), psi (c ⊗ₜ[R p] u) =
      c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] (ModN.mkQ p u)) ∧
    (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (z : VK K M),
      phi (f.baseChange K z) = (f.baseChange (R p)).baseChange K (phi z)) ∧
    (∀ f : Module.End (R p) (MR p M),
      ∃ fbar : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (MR p M) p),
        (∀ u, fbar (ModN.mkQ p u) = ModN.mkQ p (f u)) ∧
        ∀ z, psi (f.baseChange K z) = fbar.baseChange K (psi z))
def ScalarReduction (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V) : Prop :=
  ∃ (hp : CharP K p) (kap : R p →+* K),
    (∀ (r : R p) (a b : ℤ), b ≠ 0 → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
      (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → kap r = (a : K) / (b : K)) ∧
    TensorMaps p K hp M kap
def ReducedBasis (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a →
  ∃ (beta : Module.Basis (Index lam) K (VK K M)) (b : ℂ),
    Principal p M y v b ∧
    (∃ (kap : R p →+* K),
      letI : Algebra (R p) K := kap.toAlgebra
      ∃ (phi : VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[R p] MR p M))
        (c : Module.Basis (Index lam) (R p) (MR p M)),
        (∀ (s : K) (m : M), phi (s ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = s ⊗ₜ[R p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
        (∀ i, iota p M (c i) = b • e y v i.val) ∧
        ∀ i, phi (beta i) = 1 ⊗ₜ[R p] (c i)) ∧
    Module.finrank K (VK K M) = lam.toNat + 1 ∧
    GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i => beta i) (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K)
def ReducedUnits (lam : ℤ) (K : Type*) [Field K] (M : Submodule ℤ V)
    (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ j : Index lam, (Nat.choose lam.toNat j.val : K) ≠ 0) ∧
  ∀ a : LatticeOps M, Agrees M x y h a →
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ lam.toNat →
      (a.X r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (a.x.baseChange K) ^ r ∧
      (a.Y r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (a.y.baseChange K) ^ r) ∧
    ∀ beta : Module.Basis (Index lam) K (VK K M),
      GeneratorFormulas lam (fun i => beta i) (a.x.baseChange K) (a.y.baseChange K) (a.h.baseChange K) →
      ∀ i j k : Index lam,
        MatrixWord lam (fun r => (a.X r).baseChange K) (fun r => (a.Y r).baseChange K) i j (beta k) =
          if j = k then beta i else 0

end SL2Reduction

MR=R⊗ℤM and iota is the actual scalar multiplication lift; identifying with its image is justified only by N002. J_i and J are preimages of that image under c↦c e_i. qmul is the actual multiplication map ℚ⊗R J→ℂ. Scalar-first VK=K⊗ℤM is the same source tensor construction with factors swapped; T014 uses this convention throughout. ModN(MR,p) is the quotient by the image of multiplication by p.
